name: Love Gearwheels
source:
The Vehicles Circle is a college circle where a few girls bond together over their love for different vehicles. Asunder, a fresh high-school graduate, enters college, meeting as a quirk of fate the different girls that are Umi, Kizuna, Yozora and Hanabira.

[From [url=https://lolsebca.itch.io/love-gearwheels]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
车辆社是一所大学里的社团，几位女孩因各自对不同车辆的喜爱而聚到一起。刚从高中毕业的Asunder进入大学，在命运的巧合下，遇见了Umi、Kizuna、Yozora与Hanabira这几位性格各异的女孩。

[摘自[url=https://lolsebca.itch.io/love-gearwheels]itch.io[/url]]
